statements.source_text: The lights prescribed in these Rules
statements.predicate: The light is prescribed by these Rules.

statements.source_text: shall have an intensity as specified in Section 8 Annex I to these Regulation
statements.predicate: The light shall have the intensity specified in Section 8 Annex I.

statements.source_text: In vessels of 50 metres or more in length
statements.predicate: The vessel is at least 50 metres in length.
A masthead light shall be visible at a minimum range of 6 miles.
A sidelight shall be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.
A sternlight shall be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.
A towing light shall be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.

statements.source_text: a white, red, green or yellow all-round light, 3 miles
statements.predicate: A white, red, green or yellow all-round light shall be visible at a minimum range of 3 miles.

open_assumptions.source_text: The lights prescribed in these Rules
open_assumptions.reason: The excerpt leaves which lights are prescribed for a vessel to other provisions. Later formalization needs the applicable light prescriptions or a way to represent them as an input.

open_assumptions.source_text: visible at the following minimum ranges
open_assumptions.reason: The excerpt gives the minimum ranges and leaves the conditions for determining whether a light is visible at a given range unspecified.
